'''Bonekrusher Ripptusk''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A small warbeast controlled by the Landbreakers. Ripptusks are far more bloodthirsty and ferocious than their untamed wilderness kin. They are absolutely loyal to the Landbreakers who tamed them.}}

==Overview==
[[Wild Tuskbeast]] tamed by Bonekrushers, Bonekrusher Ripptusks have similar appearance to the untamed variant, and notably possess offensive abilities; They attack with a bite or a leaping bite, dealing Physical damage.
